title: Hold a private adoption agency licence
what: Arrange or negotiate adoptions, or help prepare adoption plans, only as the CEO or as a private adoption agency (a body corporate) licensed by the Minister.

sources.title: Adoption Act 1994 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not — (a) make an arrangement for or towards or with a view to the adoption of a child; or (b) conduct negotiations for or towards or with a view to the adoption of a child;

sources.title: Adoption Act 1994 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: a private adoption agency, where the adoption service is conducted under and in accordance with a licence provided for by Division 2.

sources.title: Adoption Act 1994 (WA)

sources.quote: The Minister may grant a licence to a body corporate to conduct adoption services and to perform other functions for the purposes of this Act.
